description: Absolute URLs that are allowed to appear as plain text inside dist/. Every entry is an inert string embedded by a library (an XML namespace id, or a link inside an error message). None of them is ever requested; the CSP (connect-src 'self') would block it if it were. Keep this list minimal: anything new that shows up in a build must be looked at and either removed from the source or added here with a reason.

allow.reason: XML, SVG, MathML and xlink namespace identifiers that react-dom compares against when creating elements; identifiers, not links
React production build error text ('visit https://react.dev/errors/NNN'); only ever shown inside an error message
/wb-precache is in a workbox-precaching error message (service worker); /2kdckMn is in a Dexie 'transaction committed too early' error message
Dexie 'IndexedDB API missing' error message text
zod's JSON Schema export writes these as the value of the $schema field of a generated schema object; an identifier string
zod's IPv6 validator builds 'http://[' + address + ']' only to test it with new URL(); the string is never fetched
